annotations.title: See what people budget for a job

description: Use this when someone asks what a home job or errand costs or what to pay for it, e.g. "how much to mow a lawn", "what do movers charge", "what should I pay for TV mounting". Returns the middle budget and the middle half of budgets that people set when they posted that job on GigNGo, with how many posts it counts and a link to the cost guide. These are budgets from across the US, not quotes, not local prices and not prices paid for finished jobs: say so, with the number of posts. A job with fewer than 5 posts has no figure; the reply then lists the jobs that do. Pass on the `limits` field.

job.description: The job in a few words, e.g. "lawn mowing", "moving help", "tv mounting".
